text:
QUOTE: "`data` ... Cleared by: Rebuild (`index(action='refresh')`)" and "`code` ... Client restart only. The running process holds old logic." Also: "`schema`, server older than index, or `code`: restart the MCP client. Rebuilding does nothing for these."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the axes are cleared by different actions (a rebuild for data, a client restart for code, because rebuilding can't fix them). That is why a single stale flag wouldn't tell the caller what to do. It never says that last point in so many words.
